description: Fires when column 1 (second from the left) holds exactly one stone, so the next stone there would land on row 1, and the board is fairly full: mostly from move ~15 on, more so with full columns (especially 0, 2, 3), a tall center column, and when the last move was that first stone in column 1. Doesn't fire if column 1 is empty or has 2+ stones. Early-game cases rarely fire.
effect: Small and inconsistent: shifts column 1's probability by a few points (-3 to +8 when steered/zeroed on different positions); elsewhere under 3 points.
notes: Column-1-height-1 is near necessary (all ~230 sampled firing positions). Context modulates strongly: total stones, full columns, col3 height, last move in col1. Scores: h1==1&h0+h2>=3 F1 .425; +full/last1 .478; ply-based .581; +col3>=5 .592; thr 23 .596 (P .48 R .78, sim .73). Remaining errors depend on stone colours/parity (adding one far stone can flip it off) which I could not express simply.
